visualDifferences: 彩色源头部偏三分之四且很小，重绘放大并整理了上部线路和下缘，头部曲线与眼环粗细含 AI 解释。
中灰和浅灰替代紫色/蓝色，存在轻微灰阶渐变；不是像素抠图，也不是官方原生头像。
隔离头部时排除颈部和大叶领，脸帽交界与眼睛大小经过图标化整理。
灰阶、较粗的单目圈及下颌轮廓属于参考重绘，未恢复隐藏正面细节。
保留源图三分之四朝向，长冠、脸侧及牙齿放大整理，侧脸细节含 AI 图标解释。
上冠为近黑色，边缘灰色条带和浅色眼脸用于后续染色；长冠使整头很宽，需生产圆盘 UI 再确认缩放。
透明最小边距低于提示的约 14%，但实看尖端完整且无边缘接触；原生像素未裁切或缩放。
源头很小，重绘放大了石块侧颊斜面、口槽和裂纹。裂纹位置、面部宽高及斜面不是源图逐像素结构。
剔除身躯能量后采用中灰岩石和浅灰眼区，轻微灰阶渐变没有经程序处理。
眉簇和脸颊宽度、口鼻及牙形作图标化概括；不是动画帧的像素提取。
原图绿色眼睛转换为浅灰眼形，虎纹保留为深灰。
生成图存在原生灰阶渐变，非严格两色。
v1 错抄风格图中终极神力暴龙侧刺/恐龙脸；v2 一次解剖编辑移除全部侧刺，改圆短头和分节嘴。
v2 的头片相对源精灵稍高、嘴部转成简化分节线；供根代理继续解剖审核，不自动视作正式采用。
视角更接近正面，保留原生渐变和抗锯齿，不是原游戏素材裁切。
源张口牙排和下巴褶线作简化，牙尖/舌线不是逐像素对应。
没有复制风格示例的终极形态角和侧刺，图标自身没有新角。
源橙色皮肤改灰，使用少量灰阶阴影。
源截图顶部的角尖不完整，生成稿为完整头像有限补全两端尖点；端点长度/曲率是 AI 补全，不声称来源清晰可见。
头像边界在下巴下方闭合，取消连入肩部的长颈；脸宽、齿形和角长作图标化。
颜色转换为灰阶，原生渐变保留。
尖头与下脸被整理为居中的图标比例，原参考脸部不对称与绿色斑点省略。
浮空装置放大并简化为正面圆盘；双眼内浅灰区域为图标化表达。
保留原生灰阶渐变、抗锯齿与 alpha 边缘；这是 AI 参考重绘，不是官方头像或动画帧像素提取。
Surge 没有可独立划分的人形头部；此资源是上端眼部模块的抽象图标。
模块方向调整为正面略带侧面厚度，短电路轨迹和边框比例经过 AI 简化，模块下端以图标边界截断。
保留原生灰阶渐变、抗锯齿与 alpha 边缘；这是 AI 参考重绘，不是官方头像或动画帧像素提取。
头像是第三方应用的正面简化图标；中央刃由参考的后弯侧姿改为直立，双颌装置改作短条。
重启版电影身体装甲及比例由本形态全身图表达；这不是重启版专属官方头像。
第三方头像把参考中向上弯的侧角简化为外斜直角，并采用较宽且圆的下脸；不是该近景逐帧提取。
星点、省略的小面部高光与正面比例属于简化；参考 GIF 的社区标注与动画画面支持此形态，官方发布链及精确影片时码仍未核实。

independentActualFloat32SurfaceDistance.reason: Extra dense-source proximity sampling was stopped after resource pressure; it is not needed for the independently completed exact LoD-to-F32 transform proof. No converter samples are relabeled as independent.

assemblies.original: The four source meshes retain the same 0.013 scale and positive-determinant rigid rotations/translations. Source assemble_item transforms are print-bed placements, not a proven assembled watch. Current mating is measured project placement; no part-specific shrinking. Core-neck/ring internal contact remains disclosed, not certified collision-free.
assemblies.af: Complete source object retained; no extra borrowed face/core is stacked on it.
assemblies.ua: Two subsets use the same source transform and retain original relative positions; source-connected dial has no fabricated moving core.
assemblies.ov: Seven source parts retain their local geometry with measured project placements. Original single lid remains whole and fixed; two unverified locating pins are excluded from display and preserved in the original source archive.

buttonBasisCorrection.issue: An earlier candidate button frame had singular scales 0.01300201747 / 0.013 / 0.01299798222 rather than a pure rotation times 0.013.
buttonBasisCorrection.correction: Orthogonalized tangent against the measured outward normal and rebuilt its companion cross-product basis.

excludedPins.reason: Original pin geometry retained privately; mating position has not been established. Excluded from current display without modifying or deleting source file.
Original pin geometry retained privately; mating position has not been established. Excluded from current display without modifying or deleting source file.

scope.ovLidCombination: Each lid fraction checked independently of each core fraction; wider than actual coupled animation.
scope.method: Read every retained source-mesh vertex from actual f32 files after byte/hash checks. Use production pose metadata but independent camera-basis and perspective arithmetic, not projectWatchFace or renderer project(). Convert canvas coordinates to CSS stage coordinates. Require all entity vertices within both GPU canvas/clipping planes and clipped stage rectangle. Canvas CSS rectangle may exceed stage.
exclusions: No browser layout execution: stage/container dimensions are explicit sampled inputs and exact CSS declarations are checked.
No camera interpolation paths between the four view endpoints.
No CSS drop shadows, glow, portrait slots, labels or hero projection; only actual mesh entities.
No user visual acceptance, physical phone or SillyTavern validation.
scope.sourceMotionNote: When sourceMotion disables a core or lid, the parameter samples intentionally repeat its fixed geometry; there is no fabricated motion or fabricated lid split.
scope.continuousMotionReasoning: For a fixed camera each core/lid vertex is translated along one fixed axis. Each projected coordinate is a ratio of affine functions of that single motion parameter; positive near-depth verified at endpoints makes the coordinate monotonic or constant. Therefore endpoints bound its continuous motion, with quarter-step checks retained. This argument does not cover camera interpolation.

offlineVisualReview.scope: Independent inspection of source-versus-LoD four-angle offline orthographic render comparisons. This is not a browser/material/physical-phone acceptance.

parts.observation: Wrist opening, side circular seat, raised paired tubes and wide shell bands remain in all four offline views.
Four spherical protrusions, annular opening and stepped/sloped ring edges remain.
Hourglass-shaped recessed lines, inner circular rim and lower cylindrical flange remain.
Dome and flared bezel silhouette remain. The magnified offline LoD image has visible faceting; runtime smooth normals and small-screen appearance require separate browser review.

sourceGeometryBoundary.goal: Preserve supplied shapes with the authorized Reboot display LoD, rather than make all source meshes watertight or collision-free.
sourceGeometryBoundary.detail: Source parts may already include coincident or intersecting surfaces. Those are not automatically remeshed. The Reboot source Core has two zero-area source faces, explicitly listed in the converter evidence; no claim of a printable closed solid is made.

limits: QEM changes Reboot triangle tessellation and introduces measured finite surface differences; it is not exact original-face preservation.
Surface samples are finite estimates, not global Hausdorff bounds or guarantees of every tiny feature.
Uniform local shape preservation does not prove an original mechanical assembly; source archives contain print-layout metadata.
Material colors/finish and displayed motions are project choices, not recovered official source material or animation.

No claim of official production assets, printer-ready solid topology, mechanical collision clearance, browser/physical-phone/SillyTavern acceptance, exported bundle verification, Git or publication follows from this report.
Extra verifier memory pressure is not evidence of runtime renderer performance.

visualNotes: Four source variants viewed in the production selector. Reboot Season 1 uses the disclosed source-derived 120k QEM LoD; the other three preserve supplied source coordinates.
Projection body enlarged; translucent ring reveals the case underneath. Actual viewport widths are recorded, separate from requested overrides.

Original source parts carry authored material classes. The shader adds analytic grain, roughness and studio-panel reflections, with no added face plates, geometry paint cuts, or per-frame texture fetch.
Screenshots may include a document region taller than the viewport; viewport dimensions record the actual responsive layout width.
